user.title: Add iCalendar feed
user.description: Create one secure iCalendar URL for multiple calendars. Include exports only the selected calendars. Exclude exports all calendars except those selected; leave the list empty to export all calendars.

data_description.feed_name: Name shown for this calendar feed in apps like Google Calendar or Apple Calendar. Leave empty to use the default name.
data_description.geocoding_url: Nominatim-compatible search endpoint. Sends event locations to this provider for Apple Calendar maps. Leave empty to disable. See the documentation for provider requirements.
data_description.history_weeks: How far back to include past events, in weeks (e.g. 4 for a month, 52 for a year). Set to 0 to exclude past events.
data_description.future_weeks: How far ahead to include upcoming events, in weeks (e.g. 4 for a month, 52 for a year).
